name: Technology
key_conventions: Technical skills, tools, and programming languages are often listed clearly and prominently
Links to a portfolio, GitHub profile, or personal projects are commonly included where relevant
Specific, quantifiable outcomes (e.g. performance improvements, users served) are often valued over general descriptions
regulatory_considerations: Roles involving personal data commonly require awareness of data protection principles (e.g. UK/EU GDPR)
Some technology roles, especially in regulated sectors like finance or healthcare, may require specific security clearances or background checks
terminology_notes: 'Tech stack' — the specific combination of programming languages, frameworks, and tools used
'Full-stack' — experience across both front-end and back-end development
source_note: General conventions only, based on common technology-sector recruitment practice — individual employers and roles vary, and the specific job description should always take priority.
